Available on eligible purchases of $75 or more.2Explore our cardsFor your travel needsCiti® / AAdvantage® Platinum Select® cardPremium travel benefitsCiti® / AAdvantage® Globe™ cardFor businessCiti® / AAdvantage Business™ cardLimited time offerCiti® / AAdvantage® Executive cardFAQsHow many AAdvantage® miles do you earn when you purchase flights with the American Airlines AAdvantage® MileUp® Card?
American Airlines AAdvantage® MileUp® cardmembers earn 2 AAdvantage® miles for every dollar spent on eligible American Airlines purchases — and every AAdvantage® mile earned gets you one step closer to redeeming exciting rewards. AAdvantage® miles can be redeemed for flights to nearly 1,000 destinations worldwide, flight upgrades, car rentals and hotels.
Does the American Airlines AAdvantage® MileUp® Card offer rewards?
Absolutely! The American Airlines AAdvantage® MileUp® Card issued by Citi® was designed for cardmembers to earn AAdvantage® miles simply based on their everyday purchases. These rewards allow cardmembers to:
Earn 2 AAdvantage® miles for every dollar spent at grocery stores and on eligible American Airlines purchases
Earn 1 AAdvantage® mile for every dollar spent on all other purchases
Does the American Airlines AAdvantage® MileUp® Card have any inflight benefits?
The American Airlines AAdvantage® MileUp® Card offers cardmembers 25% savings on inflight food and beverage purchases when they use their card on American Airlines flights.
Does the American Airlines AAdvantage® MileUp® Card have an Annual Fee?
One of the premium perks of being an American Airlines AAdvantage® MileUp® cardmember is that there is no Annual Fee.1
How can I apply for the American Airlines AAdvantage® MileUp® Card?
We aim to make the application process for the American Airlines AAdvantage® MileUp® Card as easy and straightforward as possible. Learn more and apply online.
Read more American Airlines AAdvantage® MileUp® Card FAQsWhat benefits does the American Airlines AAdvantage® MileUp® Card have?
The American Airlines AAdvantage® MileUp® Card issued by Citi® was created to provide keen travelers with exceptional benefits, simply for using their card for everyday purchases. Some of these benefits include:
Earn 2 AAdvantage® miles for every dollar spent at grocery stores and on eligible American Airlines purchases
Earn 1 AAdvantage® mile for every dollar spent on all other purchases
A 25% savings on inflight food and beverage purchases when you use your card on American Airlines flights
Do you get lounge access with the American Airlines AAdvantage® MileUp® Card?
The American Airlines AAdvantage® MileUp® Card does not provide lounge access. However, it does offer cardmembers other benefits, including the opportunity to earn AAdvantage® miles on their everyday purchases.2
Those interested in having lounge access through their credit card are encouraged to learn more about the Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive World Elite® Mastercard as it offers this, in addition to many other valuable perks.
Can you redeem your AAdvantage® miles for flights?
Absolutely! AAdvantage® miles can be redeemed for flights to nearly 1,000 destinations around the world. In addition, AAdvantage® miles can also be redeemed for flight upgrades, hotels and even car rentals. You can decide what to use them for, to help you make the most of your travels.
What can you redeem your AAdvantage® miles for?
You can redeem your AAdvantage® miles for a wide selection of exciting travel rewards, including:
Flights to around 1,000 destinations across the globe on American Airlines, American Eagle®, any oneworld® airline or any partner airline
Upgrades to the next cabin on most domestic and international flights marketed and operated by American Airlines, British Airways and Iberia
Car rentals and hotel stays in over 500 destinations worldwide
Does the American Airlines AAdvantage® MileUp® Card have a sign-up bonus?
The American Airlines AAdvantage® MileUp® Card frequently offers cardmembers American Airlines AAdvantage® bonus miles after the cardmember fulfills the terms and conditions of the offer. Learn about the current bonus offer for the American Airlines AAdvantage® MileUp® Card
Is the first checked bag free with the American Airlines AAdvantage® MileUp® Card?
The first checked bag is not free for the American Airlines AAdvantage® MileUp® Card. However, there are many other great benefits available with this travel card, with no Annual Fee.1
Does the American Airlines AAdvantage® MileUp® Card allow for preferred boarding?
Preferred boarding is not a benefit included with the American Airlines AAdvantage® MileUp® Card.
